name: openwrt
title: OpenWrt
description: Monitor OpenWrt status, search clients, manage DHCP/DNS, Wi-Fi QR codes, services, WireGuard, logs, connections, processes, and firewall/UPnP via ubus.
author: ooodnakov

commands.name: router-status
commands.title: Router Status
commands.subtitle: OpenWrt
commands.description: View router uptime, load average, memory, storage, temperatures, interfaces, and Wi-Fi radios

commands.name: search-clients
commands.title: Search Clients
commands.subtitle: OpenWrt
commands.description: Search connected DHCP leases and Wi-Fi clients and copy IP or MAC addresses

commands.name: manage-services
commands.title: Manage Services
commands.subtitle: OpenWrt
commands.description: Inspect and control OpenWrt init.d services and VPN / WireGuard network interfaces

commands.name: quick-status-check
commands.title: Quick Status Check
commands.subtitle: OpenWrt
commands.description: Run quick WAN, DNS, ping, Wi-Fi, and service health checks from your router

commands.name: dhcp-dns
commands.title: DHCP & Local DNS
commands.subtitle: OpenWrt
commands.description: View, add, and delete OpenWrt static DHCP reservations and local DNS records

commands.name: wifi-manager
commands.title: Wi-Fi & QR Code
commands.subtitle: OpenWrt
commands.description: View Wi-Fi SSIDs, generate scannable Wi-Fi QR codes, toggle SSIDs and radios, and scan nearby channels

commands.name: system-logs
commands.title: System Logs
commands.subtitle: OpenWrt
commands.description: Search and filter live OpenWrt syslog entries by severity, daemon, and line limit

commands.name: connections-processes
commands.title: Connections & Processes
commands.subtitle: OpenWrt
commands.description: Inspect active NAT connections (conntrack) and monitor or signal router processes

commands.name: firewall-upnp
commands.title: Firewall & UPnP
commands.subtitle: OpenWrt
commands.description: View, add, toggle, and delete UCI port forwards and manage active UPnP / NAT-PMP leases

preferences.name: routerUrl
preferences.title: Router URL
preferences.description: Base URL or IP/hostname of your OpenWrt router. /ubus is appended automatically.

preferences.name: username
preferences.title: Username
preferences.description: OpenWrt LuCI / ubus login username (defaults to root).

preferences.name: allowInsecureTls
preferences.title: Self-Signed HTTPS
preferences.label: Accept self-signed router TLS certificates
preferences.description: Allow uhttpd's default self-signed HTTPS certificate when connecting to your LAN router.

preferences.name: pingTargets
preferences.title: Quick Check Ping Targets
preferences.description: Comma-separated IPs or hostnames probed during Quick Status Check.

preferences.name: dnsTestDomain
preferences.title: DNS Check Domain
preferences.description: Domain queried via the router's local resolver (127.0.0.1) during Quick Status Check.

preferences.name: pinnedServices
preferences.title: Pinned Services
preferences.description: Comma-separated service or interface names highlighted in Manage Services and verified in Quick Status Check.
